title: 第1章 这是哪尊神搁这直播呢第2章 决定扮演雷祖
slug: 别人听劝仿明星你开局扮神明
content_zh:
烟海大学，人工湖。
学校成立的几十年间，建筑在不断的翻新，学生也换了一茬又一茬，但是这个人工湖却一直保留到了现在。
人工湖的周围，有着一圈高耸的大树，并且设置了不少休息长椅。
每到夏天的傍晚日落之时，总有一些校内的小情侣，在这里说些悄悄话、卿卿我我的，做些不可描述的事情。
而现在正值开学前老生陆续返校、新生接连报到的时候。
人工湖旁的长椅上，已经没有什么空闲的位置了。
靠近树荫最近的一对小情侣，几乎脸贴脸凑在一起，不知在谈些什么。
意浓之时，女生害羞的闭上了眼睛，而男生则呼吸急促，两人的脸凑得越来越近……
“咳咳。”
突然！
一阵咳嗽声响起，惊着了正要享受亲密时刻的两人。
鼻尖都差点碰在一起的两人，迅速的弹开，男生一脸气愤的，朝着咳嗽声发出的身边看去，正想破口大骂。
“你……”
然而，扭过头的他，却看见了一个身穿白色衬衫、黑色长裤，长相相当严肃威严的男人，站在他们二人的身边，正居高临下的看着他们。
那双眼睛波澜不惊、还带着些审视的意味，就像是看违纪学生的校领导一般！
给男生看的是心惊肉跳的，魂儿都差点吓没了。
意识到可能触到了学校领导眉头的男生，连忙找补道：
“老师，您是不是要在这里坐？”
男生边说着，边拉着一旁捂着脸，不知道该如何是好的女生站了起来。
“老师您坐，我们就不打扰您了，再见！”

被校领导撞见了这档子事，任凭谁，都不可能继续在这里待着了。
为了防止校领导追上来，对他们进行一系列的思想教育，甚至是给他俩安排上什么过错、当成学校批评的典型，两人那是一溜烟跑得飞快。
“哎！
等等……”
然而那个穿着白衬衫，长相相当严肃，被当成了校领导的男人，却伸出了手，一脸可惜的表情，想要留住那一对学生。
“哈哈哈哈。”
他的身后也传来了一阵爽朗的笑声。
一个身高不高，但是身材健硕的男生说道：
“林楠，你的样子可太唬人了。”
“那一对学长学姐，估计是把你当成抓违纪的校领导了。”
一旁长得白胖的男生，也笑得前仰后合的。
content_en:
Yanhai University, artificial lake.
In the decades since the school was founded, the buildings have been constantly renovated, and the students have changed one after another, but the artificial lake has been preserved until now.
There is a circle of towering trees around the artificial lake, and there are many resting benches.
Every summer evening at sunset, there are always some young lovers on campus whispering, making love, and doing indescribable things.
And now is the time when old students are returning to school one after another and new students are reporting in before school starts.
There are no free spaces on the benches next to the artificial lake.
The young couple closest to the shade of the tree were almost face to face, talking about something unknown.
When she was so interested, the girl closed her eyes shyly, while the boy breathed quickly, and their faces got closer and closer...
"Ahem."
Suddenly!
A cough sounded, startling the two people who were about to enjoy an intimate moment.
The two people, whose noses almost touched each other, quickly bounced away. The boy looked angrily towards the side where the coughing sound came from, and was about to curse.
"You..."
However, when he turned his head, he saw a man wearing a white shirt and black trousers with a serious and dignified appearance, standing beside the two of them, looking at them condescendingly.
Those eyes were calm and scrutinizing, like a school leader looking at students who violated discipline!
What the boys saw was so frightening that they almost lost their souls.
Realizing that he might have offended the school leader, the boy quickly added:
"Teacher, do you want to sit here?"
As the boy said this, he pulled the girl aside and covered her face. The girl who didn't know what to do stood up.
"Teacher, please sit down and we won't disturb you anymore. Goodbye!"
If the school leaders discovered this, no one would be able to stay here anymore.
In order to prevent the school leaders from catching up, they conducted a series of ideological education on them, and even assigned them some faults and used them as models for criticism by the school. The two of them ran away as fast as possible.
"Hey!
Wait..."
However, the man in a white shirt, who looked quite serious and was regarded as the school leader, stretched out his hand with a pity expression on his face, wanting to keep the pair of students.
"Hahahaha."
A burst of hearty laughter also came from behind him.
A boy who is not tall but has a strong body said:
"Lin Nan, you look so bluffing."
"That pair of seniors probably think of you as the school leader who catches disciplinary offenders."
The fair and fat boy beside him was also laughing so hard.
